```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
```

```{r preamble, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$survey)) {
  cat("> **Survey wave:** ", params$survey, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
cat("**Total variables:** ", length(params$entries), "\n\n", sep = "")
if (length(params$not_in_data) > 0) {
  cat("**Instrument variables not in data (", length(params$not_in_data), "):** ",
      paste0("`", params$not_in_data, "`", collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

---

```{r variables, results='asis'}
for (entry in params$entries) {

  # --- Heading ---
  cat("## `", entry$variable_id, "` \u2014 ", entry$title,
      " {#", entry$variable_id, "}\n\n", sep = "")

  # --- Type badge ---
  cat("**Type:** `", entry$storage_type, "`", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(entry$vargroup)) {
    cat(" &nbsp;&nbsp; **Variable group:** `", entry$vargroup, "`", sep = "")
  }
  if (!is.null(entry$universe)) {
    cat(" &nbsp;&nbsp; **Universe:** ", entry$universe, sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Question / Description text ---
  if (!is.null(entry$text) && nchar(trimws(entry$text)) > 0) {
    cat(entry$text, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  # --- Value labels ---
  if (!is.null(entry$value_labels) && length(entry$value_labels) > 0) {
    vl <- entry$value_labels
    cat("**Value labels**")
    if (!is.null(entry$value_label_id)) {
      cat(" (`", entry$value_label_id, "`)", sep = "")
    }
    cat(":\n\n")
    cat("| Value | Label |\n")
    cat("|-------|-------|\n")
    for (i in seq_along(vl$values)) {
      cat("| ", vl$values[i], " | ", vl$labels[i], " |\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }

  # --- Response counts (codebook entries only) ---
  if (!is.null(entry[["status"]])) {
    esc <- function(x) gsub("|", "\\|", x, fixed = TRUE)
    if (!is.null(entry[["parent_id"]])) {
      cat("**Option of:** `", entry[["parent_id"]], "`\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    if (!is.null(entry[["options"]])) {
      cat("**Option variables:** ",
          paste0("`", entry[["options"]], "`", collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    if (entry[["status"]] == "needs_compilation") {
      cat("> **Needs compilation:** ", entry[["flags"]], "\n\n", sep = "")
    } else if (entry[["status"]] == "ok") {
      cat("**Responses:** ", entry[["n"]] %||% 0L, " valid, ",
          entry[["n_coded"]] %||% 0L, " coded missing, ",
          entry[["n_na"]] %||% 0L, " NA\n\n", sep = "")

      vals <- entry[["values"]]
      if (!is.null(vals) && nrow(vals) > 0) {
        has_label <- "label" %in% names(vals)
        cat(if (has_label) "| Value | Label | N |\n|-------|-------|---|\n"
            else "| Value | N |\n|-------|---|\n")
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(vals))) {
          if (has_label) {
            cat("| ", esc(vals$value[i]), " | ",
                if (is.na(vals$label[i])) "*(no label)*" else esc(vals$label[i]),
                " | ", vals$n[i], " |\n", sep = "")
          } else {
            cat("| ", esc(vals$value[i]), " | ", vals$n[i], " |\n", sep = "")
          }
        }
        cat("\n")
      }

      tab <- entry[["stats_table"]]
      if (!is.null(tab) && nrow(tab) > 0) {
        cat("| Statistic | Value |\n|-----------|------:|\n")
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
          cat("| ", esc(tab$statistic[i]), " | ", tab$value[i], " |\n", sep = "")
        }
        cat("\n")
      }

      mi <- entry[["missing"]]
      if (!is.null(mi) && nrow(mi) > 0) {
        cat("**Coded missing values:**\n\n| Value | Type | Label | N |\n",
            "|-------|------|-------|---|\n", sep = "")
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(mi))) {
          cat("| ", esc(mi$value[i]), " | ", esc(mi$type[i]), " | ",
              esc(mi$label[i]), " | ", mi$n[i], " |\n", sep = "")
        }
        cat("\n")
      }

      if (nzchar(entry[["flags"]] %||% "")) {
        cat("> **Flags:** ", entry[["flags"]], "\n\n", sep = "")
      }
    }
  }

  # --- Surveys used ---
  if (!is.null(params$survey)) {
    # Single-survey mode: no need to repeat
  } else if (!is.null(entry$surveys_used) && length(entry$surveys_used) > 0) {
    cat("**Surveys used:** ", paste(entry$surveys_used, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  # --- Source / citation ---
  if (!is.null(entry$cite) && nchar(trimws(entry$cite)) > 0) {
    cat("**Source:** ", entry$cite, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  # --- Notes ---
  if (!is.null(entry$note) && nchar(trimws(entry$note)) > 0) {
    cat("> **Note:** ", entry$note, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  cat("---\n\n")
}
```
